FIRST INFORMATION REPORT (Under Section 154 Cr.P.C. / Section 173 BNSS)
1. District: New Delhi, Police Station: Mandir Marg, Year: 2024, FIR No: 0412/2024, Date: 12/08/2024.
2. Acts and Sections: Indian Penal Code 1860, Sections 406, 420, 468, 471, 120-B IPC.
3. Occurrence of Offence: Day: Saturday, Date: 10/08/2024, Time: 19:30 hrs.
4. Type of Information: Written Complaint by Ramesh Gupta, Director of Apex FinTech Innovations Ltd.
5. Details of Complainant: Ramesh Gupta, s/o Late O.P. Gupta, R/o Barakhamba Road, New Delhi.
6. Details of Suspects: Sameer Verma, MD, and Vikramaditya Singhal, CFO, Zenith Cloud Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
Brief Facts: The accused dishonestly induced the complainant company to disburse escrow funds amounting to INR 4.25 Crores based on forged security audit certificate #CG-8829, knowing fully well that no escrow milestone had been deployed.

IN THE COURT OF CHIEF METROPOLITAN MAGISTRATE, PATIALA HOUSE COURTS, NEW DELHI
Crl. Misc. No. 342/2024
In the matter of: State v. Sameer Verma & Anr. (FIR No. 0412/2024, PS Mandir Marg)
ORDER ON REGULAR BAIL APPLICATION UNDER SECTION 437 CrPC / SECTION 480 BNSS
Present: Sh. R.K. Mehta, Ld. APP for the State.
Sh. Abhinav Malhotra, Advocate for the Accused / Applicants.
Heard rival submissions and perused the police case diary. Considering that the dispute primarily hinges upon a commercial agreement dated 15/01/2024 containing an arbitration clause, and that the accused have joined investigation on two occasions, I am of the considered view that custody is no longer required for interrogation. The applicants are admitted to regular bail subject to furnishing personal bonds of INR 1,00,000/- with one surety of like amount.

IN THE COURT OF METROPOLITAN MAGISTRATE, NEW DELHI
FINAL REPORT / CHARGE SHEET UNDER SECTION 173(2) Cr.P.C. / SECTION 193(3) BNSS
Police Station: Mandir Marg, District: New Delhi, Charge Sheet No: 78/2024, Date: 24/09/2024
FIR No: 0412/2024 Date: 12/08/2024
Name of Investigating Officer: Inspector Rajeshwar Singh, Badge #3812
Offences Charged: Sections 406, 420, 468, 471, 120-B of Indian Penal Code.
Accused Sent for Trial: 1. Sameer Verma, Age 42, 2. Vikramaditya Singhal, Age 39.
List of Prosecution Witnesses: 12 witnesses cited.
Brief of Prosecution Case: Investigation establishes that accused persons entered into a criminal conspiracy to misappropriate escrow funds by submitting fake bank audit confirmations.

STATEMENT OF WITNESS UNDER SECTION 161 Cr.P.C. / SECTION 180 BNSS
Police Station: Mandir Marg, FIR No: 0412/2024
Name of Witness: Ramesh Gupta, Age: 48 years, Occupation: CFO, Apex FinTech Innovations Ltd.
Address: Flat 402, Barakhamba Towers, New Delhi.
Statement recorded by: Sub-Inspector Amit Kumar.
Statement: On being questioned, I state that on 10/08/2024 at 19:30 hours, a negotiation meeting took place in the board room of Zenith Cloud Technologies. When I questioned Mr. Sameer Verma about the discrepancy in the escrow reconciliation ledger, heated verbal exchanges took place. Contrary to the initial complaint draft, there was no physical assault or brandishing of weapons. Mr. Verma only slammed the conference table and stated that the funds were utilized towards cloud infrastructure.

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA, MINISTRY OF HOME AFFAIRS
CENTRAL FORENSIC SCIENCE LABORATORY (CFSL), CBI, NEW DELHI
Report No: CFSL-2024-DOC-8914, Date of Issue: 18/09/2024
Reference: Letter No. 1290/SHO/MM dated 16/08/2024 in FIR No. 0412/2024 PS Mandir Marg.
Subject: Forensic examination of questioned digital signature and stamp on Escrow Release Certificate #CG-8829.
Description of Parcels: Parcel 'A' containing 1 Seagate 2TB Hard Drive bearing serial #NA91029.
Results of Examination: Microscopic and cryptographic analysis indicates that the digital signature hash applied on document CG-8829 does not match the public key registered with Certifying Authority CCA-India. The timestamp has been retroactively altered by 72 hours.

SEIZURE MEMORANDUM & SCENE OF CRIME PHOTOGRAPHIC LOG
PS Mandir Marg, Case FIR No. 0412/2024.
Date & Time of Seizure: 14/08/2024 at 14:15 hrs.
Location: Office cabin of Accused Sameer Verma, 4th Floor, Zenith Towers, Okhla Phase-III, New Delhi.
Physical Item Seized: One Apple MacBook Pro 16-inch, Space Grey, Serial #C02D19X8MD6R.
Photographic Attachment: Photo Exhibit P-1 showing device on executive desk with screen displaying AWS S3 console.
Note on Forensic Integrity: Noticeably, no independent civilian panchas were joined during seizure; only Constable Dahiya signed as witness. No SHA-256 hash was generated at the time of sealing the parcel.

SINGHANIA & PARTNERS LLP, ADVOCATES & LEGAL CONSULTANTS
Express Building, 9-10 Bahadur Shah Zafar Marg, New Delhi 110002
Ref: SP/LIT/2024/0812, Date: 05/08/2024
TO: 1. Zenith Cloud Technologies Private Limited, 2. Mr. Sameer Verma, Managing Director.
SUBJECT: LEGAL NOTICE FOR BREACH OF MASTER SOFTWARE ESCROW AGREEMENT DATED 15/01/2024 AND DEMAND FOR REFUND OF INR 4,25,00,000/-.
Sir,
Under instructions from and on behalf of our client, M/s Apex FinTech Innovations Ltd., we hereby serve upon you this formal demand notice. You have committed deliberate material breach of Clause 3 and Clause 7 of the Master Escrow Agreement. We hereby call upon you to cure the default within fifteen (15) days of receipt of this notice, failing which our client shall initiate civil recovery and criminal proceedings.

IN THE HIGH COURT OF DELHI AT NEW DELHI
(CRIMINAL MISCELLANEOUS JURISDICTION)
CRL. M.C. NO. 4920 OF 2024
IN THE MATTER OF: SAMEER VERMA & ANR. ...PETITIONERS
VERSUS
STATE (NCT OF DELHI) & ANR. ...RESPONDENTS
PETITION UNDER SECTION 482 OF THE CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE, 1973 (CORRESPONDING TO SECTION 528 OF BHARATIYA NAGARIK SURAKSHA SANHITA, 2023) FOR QUASHING OF FIR NO. 0412/2024 DATED 12/08/2024 REGISTERED AT PS MANDIR MARG AND ALL CONSEQUENTIAL PROCEEDINGS.
Most Respectfully Showeth:
1. That the Petitioner is a law-abiding citizen and founder of a reputed tech startup.
2. That the dispute in question is an unadulterated commercial disagreement arising out of a software development contract containing an express arbitration agreement under the DIAC rules.
3. That the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Bhajan Lal, Dalip Kaur, and Indian Oil Corporation has categorically held that criminal prosecution cannot be used as an arm-twisting tool to settle commercial debts.

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA, MINISTRY OF CORPORATE AFFAIRS
Registrar of Companies, Delhi and Haryana
CERTIFICATE OF INCORPORATION
[Pursuant to sub-section (2) of section 7 and sub-section (1) of section 8 of the Companies Act, 2013 and rule 18 of the Companies (Incorporation) Rules, 2014]
Corporate Identity Number (CIN): U72900DL2021PTC381920
I hereby certify that ZENITH CLOUD TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED is incorporated on this Twelfth day of March Two Thousand Twenty-One under the Companies Act, 2013 and that the company is limited by shares. Given under my hand at New Delhi this 12th day of March 2021.
Assistant Registrar of Companies, Delhi.
